In contrast, competitor reviews (Pipedrive) directly mention mobile app quality, with some users finding it 'very practical' (rating 5) while others note it 'lacking in features compared to the desktop version' or 'performance isn't so good' (still rating 5, but highlighting a friction). Given the system administrator's role, they would likely appreciate the customization options of Zoho CRM, but the critical task of using the mobile app for sales tracking could expose potential usability gaps if the mobile experience isn't as polished or feature-rich as the desktop version. This suggests a slightly above-average ease-of-use rating, as Zoho generally aims for user-friendliness and customization (which can improve ease of use if configured well), but with a significant chance of encountering specific frictions related to mobile app functionality or performance, leading to a rating of 3 or 4 being most probable rather than a top score."
